args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

1. www.informations.com — Shares the latest job report: unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert). Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction that makes it easy to learn who you are and how to reach you. My feedback: it's clear and straightforward, but it feels a bit sparse — adding a short bio, a photo, and a few links to your projects or interests would make it more engaging and memorable. Great start though!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I like that it immediately gives readers a sense of your personality — hiking as a favorite hobby is a great hook and suggests plenty of potential content. My feedback: the site is welcoming and authentic, but it would benefit from actual blog posts, recent entries, and maybe some photos from your hikes to give visitors something to come back for. Keep up the outdoorsy theme — it's a lovely niche!
